utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Registrar, kindly call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honours. Good afternoon everyone in and around the courtroom and happy new year. This is case number IT-04-74-T, the Prosecutor versus Prlic et al. Thank you, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, registrar. I would also like to convey your new year wishes to all the people present in the courtroom. The team of the Prosecution that is here today in full force, I'd like to greet you. I'd like to greet Defence counsel, as well as the accused, who unfortunately are very far removed because in this room the accused are right at the back of the room. The other courtroom, courtroom III, is much more friendly-like. As you know, we shall resume these proceedings today, we shall be hearing a witness today for whom we will move into closed session, but prior to that I need to hand down two very short oral decisions. The first decision relates to the admission of Exhibit P 09848 that was tendered through Witness BC. The Prosecution presented Exhibit number P 09848 to Witness BC when the latter appeared before this court on the 28th of November, 2007. The Trial Chamber decided to admit Exhibit number P 09848 under seal that had been requested by the Prosecution through its list IC 00735 on the ground that this exhibit demonstrates sufficient evidence, reliability, and probative value. The second decision relates to the right to reply. The Trial Chamber would like to remind the parties that they expect to hear the responses for two -- for three motions. These are reply to the Defence motions. In the event that the Prosecution would like, if the need arises, to file the reply to these responses, the Trial Chamber requests that the latter be in by the 9th of January, 2008. In this way, the Trial Chamber will be able to hand down its decision pending decisions well before the 24th of January, which is the date at which the Prosecution case comes to an end. Now, as far as the schedule for the month of January is concerned, the Prosecutor has given you the list of all the witnesses who will be coming over the next few weeks. The Trial Chamber at this stage realises that the 16th of January is a day for which we have nothing, and in the week running from the 21st to the 24th of January there seems to be no witness scheduled. So I'm turning to Mr. Scott. I would like him to confirm this, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: First of all, good afternoon, Mr. President, Your Honours, welcome back after the new year and I'm sure I speak for everyone in hoping that all of you had a very good and restful holiday. As to the week of the 21st, if I can start with that and come back to the 16th because I'm looking further -- look further at that for a moment, on the week of the 21st, Your Honour, concerning that I think it's best if we go into private session, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Registrar, could we go into private session, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Tuesday, the 8th day of January, 2008, at 9.00 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 7.00 p.m.,
